text: Pathlib replaces string juggling with real path objects.
We import Path, the one class you'll use ninety percent of the time.
Every one of these paths is an object with methods, not a fragile string.
The forward slash is overloaded to join paths, and it's correct on every operating system.
No backslashes, no os dot path dot join, no separators to get wrong.
Path objects also compare, sort and work as dictionary keys.
Dot name gives the final component, report dot txt.
Dot suffix is just the extension, dot txt.
Dot stem is the name without it, report.
Dot parent walks up one level, to data.
And with suffix swaps the extension cleanly, giving report dot md.
And with suffix returns a new path, it never mutates the one you had.
Read text, write text and exists hang off the same object when you need them.
That's the Learn Python series. Start back at Fibonacci and work through them all. Comment which one you want expanded.
